subject: math.AC
name: Hilbert basis theorem
statement: If R is a commutative Noetherian ring, then the polynomial ring R[x_1, ..., x_n] is Noetherian for every finite n.

subject: math.AC
name: Hilbert Nullstellensatz
statement: Let k be an algebraically closed field and I an ideal of k[x_1, ..., x_n]. The ideal of all polynomials vanishing at every common zero of I in k^n is the radical of I; in particular, every maximal ideal has the form (x_1-a_1, ..., x_n-a_n) for a point a in k^n.

subject: math.AC
name: Noether normalization lemma
statement: Every nonzero finitely generated commutative algebra A over a field k contains algebraically independent elements y_1, ..., y_d such that A is finite as a module over k[y_1, ..., y_d]. Here d is the Krull dimension of A.

subject: math.AC
name: Nakayama lemma
statement: Let R be a commutative ring, I an ideal contained in its Jacobson radical, and M a finitely generated R-module. If IM=M, then M=0; more generally, elements whose images generate M/IM generate M.

subject: math.AC
name: Hilbert syzygy theorem
statement: Every finitely generated module over k[x_1, ..., x_n], with k a field, has a finite free resolution of length at most n.

subject: math.AC
name: Krull principal ideal theorem
statement: In a commutative Noetherian ring R, every prime ideal minimal over a principal ideal has height at most one.

subject: math.AC
name: Krull height theorem
statement: If an ideal of a commutative Noetherian ring is generated by r elements, then every prime ideal minimal over it has height at most r.

subject: math.AC
name: Krull intersection theorem
statement: For a commutative Noetherian local ring (R,m) and a finitely generated R-module M, the intersection of m^n M over all n at least zero is zero.

subject: math.AC
name: Artin-Rees lemma
statement: Let R be commutative Noetherian, I an ideal, M a finitely generated R-module, and N a submodule. There exists c such that I^n M intersected with N equals I^(n-c)(I^c M intersected with N) for every n at least c.

subject: math.AC
name: Lasker-Noether theorem
statement: Every proper ideal of a commutative Noetherian ring is a finite intersection of primary ideals. In a minimal primary decomposition, the radicals of the primary components are uniquely determined.

subject: math.AC
name: Lying-over theorem
statement: If A is a commutative subring of B and B is integral over A, then every prime ideal p of A is the contraction of a prime ideal of B.

subject: math.AC
name: Going-up theorem
statement: Suppose A is a commutative subring of B and B is integral over A. If p is contained in p_prime in Spec(A) and q in Spec(B) contracts to p, there is a prime q_prime containing q that contracts to p_prime.

subject: math.AC
name: Going-down theorem
statement: Let A be an integrally closed domain and B an integral domain integral over A. If p is contained in p_prime in Spec(A) and q_prime in Spec(B) contracts to p_prime, there is a prime q contained in q_prime that contracts to p.

subject: math.AC
name: Zariski lemma
statement: If a field extension K/k is finitely generated as a k-algebra, then K is a finite algebraic extension of k.

subject: math.AC
name: Hilbert-Samuel polynomial theorem
statement: Let (R,m) be a commutative Noetherian local ring and M a nonzero finitely generated R-module. For all sufficiently large n, the length of M/m^(n+1)M is a polynomial in n of degree equal to the dimension of the support of M.

subject: math.AC
name: Auslander-Buchsbaum formula
statement: If (R,m) is a commutative Noetherian local ring and M is a nonzero finitely generated R-module of finite projective dimension, then projective_dimension(M) + depth(M) = depth(R).

subject: math.AC
name: Auslander-Buchsbaum-Serre theorem
statement: For a commutative Noetherian local ring (R,m,k), the following are equivalent: R is regular, k has finite projective dimension over R, and R has finite global dimension. In this case the global dimension equals the Krull dimension of R.

subject: math.AC
name: Cohen structure theorem
statement: Every complete commutative Noetherian local ring is a quotient of a complete regular local ring. If it contains a field, it contains a coefficient field mapping isomorphically onto its residue field and is a quotient of a formal power series ring over that coefficient field.

subject: math.AC
name: Generic freeness lemma
statement: Let A be a commutative Noetherian domain, B a finitely generated A-algebra, and M a finitely generated B-module. There is a nonzero f in A such that M localized at f is a free module over A localized at f, possibly of infinite rank.

subject: math.AC
name: Chinese remainder theorem
statement: For pairwise comaximal ideals I_1, ..., I_r of a commutative ring R, the natural map from R/(I_1 intersect ... intersect I_r) to the product of the rings R/I_j is an isomorphism. Their intersection equals their product.
